response.what_it_is: A 2-in-1 nesting round centre table set with faux marble tops, gold-finished metal trim, and two built-in drawers.
hidden_risks: Whether the tabletops are genuine marble or laminate/sticker over wood
Durability and smoothness of the drawer tracks
Sturdiness and gauge of the metal frame
seller_claims_unsupported: luxury marble (surface appears to be manufactured wood with a marble-patterned laminate)
response.failure_mode: Overvaluing the item by assuming the top is solid genuine marble rather than synthetic laminate, or missing potential structural weaknesses in the nesting drawer mechanism.
